app.name: Facet Review
app.tagline: Every facet of your search. Traceable.

app.homeLink: Facet Review – go to start page

form.unsavedBody: Your entries in this form have not been saved yet.

database.label: Bibliographic database
database.hint: e.g. MEDLINE via Ovid, Scopus, ERIC via EBSCOhost

search_engine.label: Search engine
search_engine.hint: e.g. Google Scholar. Results are only imported as a file (e.g. from Publish or Perish or GSscraper); Facet Review does not scrape Google Scholar.

website.label: Website or online resource
website.hint: e.g. websites of professional societies, tables of contents, conference proceedings

citation_search.label: Citation searching
citation_search.hint: Forward or backward searching starting from seed documents

contact.label: Contact with experts or organisations
contact.hint: e.g. requests to authors, professional societies or manufacturers

other.label: Other method
other.hint: Any other method used to identify studies

search.empty: No sources documented yet. Add a source for every database, register and other search method.

hits.databases_registers: Reported hits from databases, registers and search engines: {{hits}}

source.deleteBlocked: {{count}} records have already been imported from “{{source}}”, so it cannot be deleted.
source.deleteBody_one: “{{source}}” will be deleted together with {{count}} search run.
source.deleteBody_other: “{{source}}” will be deleted together with {{count}} search runs.

meta.heading: Project-wide search information
meta.filtersHint: (Validated) search filters used, with their source (PRISMA-S item 10)
meta.priorWorkHint: Were search strategies from other reviews reused or adapted? (PRISMA-S item 11)
meta.updatesHint: When and how was the search updated? (PRISMA-S item 12)
meta.peerReview: Peer review of the search strategy
meta.peerReviewHint: e.g. PRESS checklist – by whom? (PRISMA-S item 14)

sourceForm.name: Name

nameHint.database: Name of the database or of the combined search, e.g. “MEDLINE” or “EBSCOhost”
nameHint.citation_search: e.g. backward searching in included studies
nameHint.contact: e.g. a professional society or research group

sourceForm.platformHint: e.g. Ovid, EBSCOhost, PubMed, Web of Science; for Scopus the same as the name (PRISMA-S item 1)
sourceForm.databasesHint: Only if one search covered several databases on one platform simultaneously. A combined search is one source (PRISMA-S item 2).

runForm.dateToHint: Optional, if the search extended over several days.
runForm.searchStringHint: Complete and exactly as executed, including line numbers (PRISMA-S item 8).
runForm.copied: Search string copied to the clipboard.
runForm.copyFailed: Copying is not possible in this browser.
runForm.limitsHint: e.g. publication years, languages, document types (PRISMA-S item 9). Empty means “not documented”.
runForm.reportedHitsHint: Number as reported by the source; compared with the number of imported records.

toolHint.search_engine: How were the results exported? e.g. Publish or Perish, GSscraper
toolHint.citation_search: e.g. manual, Citationchaser, Scopus, Web of Science

runForm.seedDocumentsHint: e.g. the included studies or specific key publications
runForm.descriptionHint: What was done and how; who was contacted with which request? (PRISMA-S items 6 and 7)
runForm.deleteBody: The search run of {{date}} will be deleted.
runForm.deleteBlocked: {{count}} records have already been imported from this search run, so it cannot be deleted.

importPage.noRuns: No search runs documented yet. Imported records always belong to a search run – please document the search first.
importPage.undoBody: The {{count}} records from “{{file}}” and the duplicate decisions about them will be deleted.
importPage.undoBlocked: Records from this file have already been screened, so the import cannot be undone.

importWizard.title: Import file
importWizard.fileHint: RIS, PubMed/MEDLINE (.nbib), BibTeX or CSV. The file is only read in your browser.
importWizard.unknownFormat: The file format was not recognised. Supported are RIS, PubMed/MEDLINE (.nbib), BibTeX and CSV.
importWizard.mappingHint: Facet Review suggested the columns from their headers. Check and correct the mapping; the title is required.
importWizard.reconciliation: Check against the reported number of hits
importWizard.mismatch: The imported number differs from the reported number of hits. Please justify the difference (e.g. export limit, several files, the database counts differently).
importWizard.noReported: No reported number of hits is documented for this search run; no check is possible.
importWizard.moreFiles: More files will follow for this search run (e.g. because of an export limit)

importWarnings.missingEnd: Record without end line (ER); kept anyway
importWarnings.unknownType: Unknown document type “{{detail}}”; kept as journal article or document
importWarnings.csvColumnCount: Row has a different number of columns than the header

duplicates.title: Review duplicates
duplicates.description: DOI and PMID matches are merged automatically. Similar titles are only proposed – you decide.
duplicates.doiConflict: Note: different DOIs – e.g. preprint and journal version, or duplicate publication

screening.openCandidates_one: {{count}} duplicate candidate is still open. When merged later, decisions are adopted or marked as a conflict.
screening.openCandidates_other: {{count}} duplicate candidates are still open. When merged later, decisions are adopted or marked as a conflict.

gate.locked_one: Stage 2 is locked: {{count}} record in stage 1 is still “maybe”. Resolve it or deliberately take “maybe” records into full-text screening.
gate.locked_other: Stage 2 is locked: {{count}} records in stage 1 are still “maybe”. Resolve them or deliberately take “maybe” records into full-text screening.
gate.setting: The setting “Take maybe records into stage 2” is at the bottom of this page.
gate.openWarning_one: Note: {{count}} record in stage 1 is not decided yet.
gate.openWarning_other: Note: {{count}} records in stage 1 are not decided yet.

screening.allDecided: All records of this stage are decided.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.maybeToFullText: Take “maybe” records into stage 2 (full text) instead of resolving them first
settings.termsHint: One term per line or separated by commas. * truncates (tutor* finds tutoring). Case and accents are ignored.
settings.deviceHint: The following settings apply to this browser only.
settings.shortcuts: Use single-key shortcuts (I, E, M, N, Z, ←, →)

screening.unitGone: This record no longer exists (for example because an import was undone).
screening.notInTitleAbstract: This record is not part of stage 1: it comes only from other methods (websites, citation searching, contacts, other) or was removed before screening.
screening.notInFullText: This record is not part of stage 2: it was not included in stage 1.

announce.endOfList: {{decision}}. That was the last record in this view.
announce.nothingToUndo: There is no decision to undo.

decision.heading: Decision
decision.reasonHint: Required in full-text screening. A digit picks directly, Enter confirms, Esc cancels.

status.inherited: Adopted from an earlier decision (duplicates merged or imported later).
status.conflict: Conflict: these records were merged as duplicates but had different decisions. Please decide once again.
status.split: Split off from a duplicate group. Earlier decision (made on another record): {{decision}}. Please review.

study.heading: Report and study
study.own: This report counts as a study of its own.
study.detach: Treat as a study of its own
study.assignLabel: Belongs to the same study as
study.detached: Report is a study of its own again.

removal.heading: Remove before screening
removal.removed: Removed before screening: {{how}} – {{note}}. Earlier decisions stay in the history but do not count.

duplicate.heading: Mark as duplicate
duplicate.merged: Merged as duplicates. Decisions of both records are adopted or marked as a conflict.
